pokedexEntries.us: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

pokedexEntries.sw: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

pokedexEntries.sh: Garchomp is fast both underground and above. It can bring down prey and return to its den before its body has chilled from being outside.
